title: Installation of the Aft Cargo Door Surround Longitudinal Splice Plates
abstract: Installation of the longitudinal splice plates on the aft cargo door surround, including the staggered double fastener row, the sealing of the pressure boundary and the door rigging and closing effort check.

sections.purpose: This task installs the longitudinal splice plates around the aft cargo door cut-out, restores the pressure seal, and re-rigs the door so that the closing effort returns inside the published limit.
sections.job_setup_note: Confirm the plate standard before you start, because the reinforced plate uses a staggered double fastener row and the original uses a single row. Do not mix standards on one cut-out. The sealant has a limited application life once mixed and the joint must be closed inside it. The door must be re-rigged and the closing effort measured before the aircraft is released.
sections.procedure: 1. Clean the faying surfaces of the cut-out and confirm that the surface protection is continuous. 2. Where the reinforced standard is being installed, ream the additional holes with the jig and do an eddy current inspection of each reamed hole. 3. Install the stringer D5230114751500 and, at the aft lower corner, the outboard angle JA880258-89. CAUTION: THE OUTBOARD ANGLE IS HANDED. CHECK THE PART MARKING AGAINST THE DRAWING BEFORE YOU DRILL. 4. Fit the edging grommet AES686504-33 where the wiring route crosses the new fastener line. 5. Mix the sealant and apply it to the faying surfaces. 6. Position the splice plates and install the fasteners wet in the staggered double row. WARNING: DO NOT APPLY FULL TORQUE UNTIL EVERY FASTENER IN THE ROW IS FITTED. UNEVEN CLAMP-UP WILL DISTORT THE CUT-OUT. 7. Torque the fasteners in the sequence given on drawing D52301184448. 8. Apply the sealant fillet around the plate edges and smooth it. 9. Let the sealant cure for the full period before you install the door. 10. Install the aft cargo door and rig it to the values given in the referenced data. 11. Re-rig the microswitch of FIN 6804WV1 and do the door warning functional test. 12. Measure the door closing effort and confirm it is inside the limit.
sections.close_out: Install the lining panels in the aft cargo compartment. Do a cabin pressurisation leak check at the door surround. Confirm from the removal sheet that every fastener has been replaced. Record the plate standard, the sealant batch, the rigging values and the measured closing effort against the aircraft.

type_data.effectivity_note: All ZEPHYR-24 aircraft; the staggered double row applies to aircraft post MOD-151633

safety_precautions: Do not mix plate standards on one cut-out.
Do not apply full torque before every fastener is fitted.
Wear gloves when you handle mixed sealant.
Support the door on the handling stand until it is hung.

tooling.description: Door handling stand, aft cargo door
